LESSON: COOKING: USING FLOUR MIXTURES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes 2.1 Organic Gardening 14
Topic 2.3: Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures
2. give Kenyan examples of Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures
3. practise a safe skill for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures

Teach
• Observe Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
